> A plain quote, as an agent quotes an error or a doc.
> It can run over two lines.

> [!NOTE]
> The bridge strips terminal escape codes before the phone sees any output.

> [!TIP]
> Long-press a table to copy it as TSV.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Every request gets exactly one answer, within 120 s.

> [!WARNING]
> This deletes the session's worktree.

> [!CAUTION]
> Force-pushing rewrites history for everyone on the branch.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- Flat blocks keep a SwiftUI `ForEach` and a Compose `LazyColumn` free of recursion.
- A block's key is its kind and the byte offset it starts at, so streaming redraws only the last block.
